confirmed_findings.title: Large finite integers crash schema/readiness validation
confirmed_findings.trigger: Set an otherwise complete synthetic band begin, end, or amount to integer10**400.
confirmed_findings.observed: All three paths raise OverflowError: int too large to convert to float.
confirmed_findings.reason: math.isfinite implicitly converts Python arbitrary-precision integers to floats, although those integers are mathematically finite.
confirmed_findings.required_action: Create a new additive revision that validates integers without floating conversion, retains explicit bool rejection, validates nonfinite floats separately, and returns a defined comparison/readiness outcome for these records. Do not add a lossy sentinel or alter the frozen r1.
confirmed_findings.probe_scope: Three supplemental robustness probes selected after reading the code. Not part of the32 expectations sealed before candidate-code inspection.
